letting the children try to understand him for themselves. They still cannot quite communicate with him, and some of his actions remain a mystery. But they learn that being different does not make him any less deserving of friendship and respect. (Child) seems perfectly content to sit among them.

allowing (child) to join the group at his own pace. Some children become close friends, others remain unsure, and a few simply learn to leave him in peace. (Teacher) is pleased that the class is beginning to respect his differences, even without understanding all of them.

legend.name: The Golden Child
legend.text: A few weeks have passed since the Golden Child of legend, (child) was born. Already he has shown unparalleled wisdom and an uncanny ability to generate things out of thin air. However, he hasn't spoken a word, even though he appears to be around five years old.

class.name: The class
class.text: The other children seem to avoid him due to his special powers. Some are frightened, some are curious, and some simply have no idea what to make of him. (Child) doesn't seem troubled, but no one can really understand what he's thinking. (Teacher), the schoolteacher, is wondering how (teacher.he/she) can help little (child) integrate better with his peers.
